reasoning: The question asks whether KRW/USD will increase (won weakens) from 2025-10-26 to 2025-11-02. As of 2025-10-16, the most recent data shows the rate at approximately 1,426 won/dollar (Oct 15). The evidence indicates the won has weakened significantly from ~1,400 in early October to 1,420-1,426 by mid-October due to dollar strength and Fed policy uncertainty. However, recent reports (Oct 15) suggest the won is strengthening as Fed rate cut expectations rise. The 7-day forecast period is short, and near-term volatility is expected. Expert forecasts range from 1,350-1,450 won by year-end depending on trade negotiations. Given the recent strengthening trend and Fed easing signals, a further increase (won weakening) over just 7 days seems less likely than stabilization or modest strengthening. The probability of the rate being higher on Nov 2 than Oct 26 is moderate but below 50%.
